description: RETIRED 2026-08-13 (CAPT-ORDER) — see retiredReason. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, description.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: ISA-95 has no link from a Level-4 customer order (owner 25.09.: only ISA-95 edges).

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Ordered piece count of the order line (menge). Together with unit_price the source for total_amount — the real ERP does not keep an order total: order value = quantity × unit_price (derived by the it-evaluator).

properties.name: unit_price
properties.description: Unit price of the order line (stueckpreis). Together with quantity the source for total_amount (= quantity × unit_price).

properties.name: total_amount
properties.description: Order value. Delivered directly where available; otherwise derived by the it-evaluator as quantity × unit_price (the real ERP has no total column). Driver of the €-impact prioritization (expected_impact).

properties.name: due_date
properties.description: Customer delivery commitment (the promised date the sales order is due).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Sales-order status, as it reaches THIS profile through OUR source binding. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, attributes › status › description.

properties.name: customer_due_date
properties.description: Customer delivery date of the order (moved here from ProductionOrder in core 3.0.0).

constraints.name: order_overdue
constraints.description: Open customer order past its due date (delivery delay against the customer commitment).
constraints.retiredReason: RETIRED. The guard is structurally unsatisfiable: `when: status eq 'offen'` keys on a value this attribute CANNOT carry. Measured 2026-07-12 against the FULL population of the reference simulator — all 47.513 customer orders, paginated (the endpoint caps a page at 500; a page is not a population). The measurement and the full reasoning: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order-retirement.md.

isa95.note: Level-4 sales order (B2MML/ERP, above the MOM boundary). Triggers a Level-3 OperationsRequest (ProductionOrder); ISA-95 has no edge for that, the reference is kept as a value. due_date = customer delivery commitment, not the production EndTime.
isa95.mappingNote: Level 4 sales order. ISA-95 stops at the MOM boundary; B2MML 0700 has no SalesOrder object.
